issue: Date stored as text
action: Parsed to datetime with an explicit format (0 failures)
reason: Needed for joins on date, lags and seasonal features

issue: Possible duplicate rows or keys
action: Checked all tables; none found. Uniqueness is enforced again by the database keys
reason: Keys must be unique for one-to-one joins

issue: Ahmedabad CO equals NO on most days (r = 0.999) although units differ 1000x
action: Set all Ahmedabad CO values to missing and flagged the rows
reason: Corrupted CO also inflates the official AQI; see the AQI rebuild step

issue: Exact 0.00 daily means for CO and NOx
action: Set to missing
reason: A city-wide daily average of exactly zero is impossible for combustion gases: these are sensor drop-outs

issue: Exact zeros in Benzene / Toluene / Xylene
action: Kept as-is
reason: Plausible 'below detection limit' readings, and these columns are not used in the models

issue: Xylene is 61% missing
action: Dropped the column
reason: Too sparse to impute or analyse reliably

issue: Stuck sensor: identical PM value repeated 4+ days in a row
action: Set to missing
reason: Real daily averages never repeat to two decimals for days; the instrument had frozen

issue: PM2.5 greater than PM10 (impossible: PM2.5 is a subset of PM10)
action: Removed whichever of the two was further from the city's normal level for that month
reason: Data-driven: PM2.5 was the abnormal value in 94% of cases, overturning our first assumption that PM10 was wrong

issue: Spikes > 3.5 robust SD above the city-month norm, outside known episodes
action: Set to missing (pm_fault_flag)
reason: Mostly monsoon days and instrument-ceiling values such as 950 and 1000 ug/m3 in clean cities: sensor faults

issue: Equally extreme values during Diwali or North India's crop-burning season
action: Kept and flagged (episode_flag)
reason: These are documented real pollution events, exactly what the project studies

issue: Short sensor gaps (1-3 consecutive days)
action: Linear interpolation within each city
reason: Pollution is autocorrelated over 1-3 days; longer gaps are left missing rather than invented

issue: Rows with no pollutant readings and no AQI
action: Dropped
reason: They carry no information (weather is joined later from its own source)

issue: Official AQI above 500 (scale maximum)
action: Capped at 500
reason: 500 is the top of the CPCB scale; higher numbers are off-scale artefacts

issue: Official AQI computed from a faulty PM reading
action: Replaced with the AQI recalculated from the cleaned pollutants
reason: Keeps the AQI consistent with the corrected measurements

issue: Ahmedabad's official AQI is driven by the corrupted CO column
action: Replaced with the AQI recalculated without CO
reason: Official numbers are not usable for this city

issue: AQI missing although pollutants were measured
action: Filled with the recalculated AQI and flagged in aqi_source
reason: Recalculation matches official AQI with r = 0.94; source kept so analyses can exclude it

issue: AQI_Bucket must agree with AQI after the changes above
action: Re-derived the category from the cleaned AQI
reason: Guarantees label and number never disagree

issue: Station status missing for 97 of 230 stations
action: Filled with 'Unknown'
reason: Missing does not mean inactive; 'Unknown' keeps the station in drill-downs

issue: StationName packs place, city and agency in one string ('Secretariat, Amaravati - APPCB')
action: Split into station_place and agency
reason: Allows filtering by monitoring agency in the dashboard

issue: Weather data quality
action: Range and completeness checks passed; no changes
reason: Reanalysis data is gap-free; checking is still required before joining

issue: 'Amaravati' matches 3 places in India
action: Geocoding restricted to the expected state (Andhra Pradesh)
reason: City names must refer to the same place in every source

issue: Kaggle 'Brajrajnagar' vs GeoNames 'Brajarajnagar'
action: Searched the GeoNames spelling, kept the Kaggle name as key
reason: City names must refer to the same place in every source

issue: Geocoder's 'Jorapokhar' is a village ~160 km from the CPCB station
action: Used Jharia (Dhanbad), where the station is
reason: City names must refer to the same place in every source
